_about: Read by scripts/ci/check-lockfile-registries.py (#271). npm_registry_hosts: hosts an npm lockfile may resolve a package from (https only). go_local_replacements: repository-relative directories a go.mod replace directive may point at. go_module_replacements: module paths a versioned go.mod replace may point at when they differ from the replaced module (with GOPROXY ending in direct, Go may fetch them from their own origin).
